_: Before Colony's raw footage for the Elo Pros platform trailer: clean 1920x1080 clips, no captions, cut and mixed elsewhere. Filmed with film.mjs as make.sh does (BC_URL serving web/dist): node film.mjs shots/elopros.json OUTDIR, then each OUTDIR/<name>/%03d.jpg to H.264 at 30 fps. The launch is the cockpit's view as the bay's doors stand open and down the tunnel (the colony's own launch from bay 1 happens in the colony's shadow, too dark to read). The colony with Earth behind pushes in faster than 6 km/s, where the dust stops streaking (ambience.rs). The Markab and the city take SwiftShader minutes a frame: the Markab is filmed at 1600x900 (scaled up after), and the city's two are single frames (len 0) a clip pushes in on. Of the Markab's 1.6 s only its first half-second (15 frames) was filmed in time.
